name: tmux-recording
description: Terminal recording to narrated video (record in tmux, narrate, voice locally, assemble), plus anidoodle for animated explainers.

plugins.name: terminal-video
plugins.description: Record a terminal run in tmux, narrate it from what the screen showed, voice it locally (Kokoro, or VoiceStudio), and assemble the narrated video.

plugins.name: anidoodle
plugins.description: Optional. Code-drawn films and explainers by Alex Greenshpun; builds an animated explainer from a `tvid bundle`. Listed here pinned to the release tested with terminal-video.
